_comment: SMLA pytest/NPU 验证环境配置。未知项填 null，运行 probe_smla_test_env.sh 可自动探测并回写。

conda.notes: 若 conda 不在 PATH，可手动填写 python_executable 绝对路径

ascend.notes: A2/A3 对应 arch22 + ascend910b；set_env.sh 内 version_dirpath 指向 cann-9.1.0

python_packages.notes: cann_ops_transformer 来自 torch_extension 编译安装的 whl

build.torch_extension_build_command: cd /data/hey/git/ops-transformer/torch_extension && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 -m build --wheel -n && python3 -m pip install dist/*.whl --force-reinstall --no-deps
build.install_notes: 算子 pkg 安装到 ${ASCEND_HOME_PATH}/opp/vendors；PTA whl 需与 CANN/torch_npu 版本匹配

run_commands.run_single_case: cd /data/hey/git/ops-transformer/attention/sparse_flash_mla/tests/pytest && python3 -m pytest -rA -s test_sparse_flash_mla_single.py -v -m ci -k dspark_swa_sparse
run_commands.run_cpu_golden_only:
cd /data/hey/git/ops-transformer/attention/sparse_flash_mla/tests/pytest && python3 - <<'PY'
import utils
from sparse_flash_mla_paramset import TEST_PARAMS
import sparse_flash_mla_golden as g
params = utils.generate_case_with_default_param({**TEST_PARAMS['dspark_swa_sparse'], 'testcase_name': ['dspark_swa_sparse']})
data = g.gen_data(params)
print('ori_sparse_indices', data['input']['ori_sparse_indices'].shape)
print('cpu_output', data['cpu_output'].shape)
PY
